name: Costume Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Art

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the artist’s touch power of the art domain.

Assume the Role (Sp)

You gain the ability to use disguise self a number of times equal to 3 plus your Wisdom modifier. At 8th level this becomes alter self.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st–vocal alteration, 5th–seeming, 9th–shapechange
